**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** About 130 g and roughly 280 kcal is plausible for two bread slices, half an avocado, an egg and a muffin sandwich on a 20 cm plate covered about 45%. The filling in the muffin is hard to identify, so its contribution is approximate.
